title: Package, scope and prediction
body: Record package identity, actual environment and evidence class. No hidden installation and no unsafe example launch.

title: Trust-boundary map
body: Trace principal, constant action, server resource and body fields. Predict allow, forbid, conceal or state conflict.

title: P02 implementation segment
body: Edit only authorization-policy.js. Keep authentication and CSRF support separate from the policy task.

label: P02
title: Deny by default
body: Unsupported actions fail at configuration. Missing principal is 401. Missing resource is 404. No body field grants authority.

label: P02
title: Allowed path
body: Load the resource once, decide with trusted principal/resource, freeze the flat snapshot and call next exactly once.

label: P02
title: Forbidden and concealed
body: Ordinary 403 and concealed 404 serve different disclosure policies. Record which route option applies.

label: P02
title: State precondition
body: Permission can pass while the supplied route rejects the current resource state with 409. Do not call this authorisation denial.

label: P02
title: Evidence limits
body: A callback model is not Express ordering. A frozen flat clone is not a transaction or database lock.

title: Protective observations
body: Record allowed, forbidden, concealed, loader count and state-precondition witnesses with locators.

title: Bounded Gemini critique
body: Use one sanitised policy claim and minimal excerpt. Do not request the complete solution.

title: Independent verdict
body: Check against source, named tests or actual observation. Use one of the four defined verdicts and retain the limit.

label: P03
title: Reduced route authority
body: 11.3A uses CORS and CSRF by local design. The original all-five starter is private and is not launched.

label: P03
title: CORS evidence
body: Exact-origin allow/refuse, Vary, credentials and preflight. HTTP refusal and browser sharing are distinct.

label: P03
title: CSRF evidence
body: Safe methods, cookie-authenticated writes, matching/missing controls and redaction. A fixture token is not a production secret.

label: P01
title: Capstone transfer
body: Authentication/session integration continues in the semester project. Do not include credentials or raw session data in this PDF.

title: Evidence draft and STOP
body: Record remaining required work. Export only after actual review. STOP at minute 60; no invented deadline.
